item.title: Deloras Marie Sanders
item.description: Deloras “Dee” Marie Sanders, a beloved figure known for her spirited personality and deep love for her family, passed away on February 14, 2026, at Sunflower Care Homes of Baldwin in Baldwin City, Kansas. Born on December 16, 1938, in Melvern, Kansas, she was the daughter of Albert and Marie (Maiden) Boyer. Dee spent sixty-two wonderful years married to her husband, Shorty Sanders. Together, they built a life full of love and memories that continue to resonate within their family.
